description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the DefaultMongoDbConfig class, which is part of a MongoDB configuration module. The tests verify immutability, equality, string representation, and that the configuration values match expected defaults or resource file contents.

classes.name: DefaultMongoDbConfigTest
classes.description: A Java JUnit test class that tests the behavior and configuration of the DefaultMongoDbConfig class, ensuring correctness in immutability, equality, string representation, and default values.

methods.name: initMongoDbConfig
methods.description: Initializes the rawMongoDbConfig by parsing the resource configuration file 'mongodb_test.conf' before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that the DefaultMongoDbConfig class and its related config classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the DefaultMongoDbConfig class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the string representation of the DefaultMongoDbConfig object contains expected class name and configuration keys.

methods.name: defaultMongodbConfigContainsExactlyValuesOfResourceConfigFile
methods.description: Validates that the configuration object correctly reflects the values provided in the resource config file.

methods.name: defaultMongodbConfigContainsExactlyFallBackValuesIfEmptyResourceConfigFile
